posts.title: Deep Appreciation
posts.description: Deep Appreciation Last year at this time was not a great time for me. I had painful dry eye problems and my wieght was increasing to a new record high. My whole attitude today is one of deep appreciation for existence and all of the good fortune in my life. posts.title: A Man and A Woman
posts.description: A Man and A Woman The title refers to a 1966 film directed by Claude Lelouch. This is one of the best films I have seen in a while. It has to go somewhere high on my all time list of best films. We have taken on classic films as a new hobby interest for this Fall and Winter. posts.title: Cozy
posts.description: Cozy My major theme this Fall has been cozy (or cosy for the UK crowd). We realized that our house has become quite cozy to us, and that we love it this way. It is relativity small, and we - mostly my wife - have had remodels done that have tailored it to our needs and tastes. Our furnishing is eclectic and accumulated randomly over many years.
